chapter: Becoming a player; Rene, Bunk and Armstrong
title: The 1921 month-long visit to New Orleans
summary: Why he first came back in 1921, a month with his aunt, without playing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh let me ask you something. When was it you came back to Nosey and how long did you stay?
Well after 21, then I came back in 31.
No but the first time you came back you said that's before you even started really playing music.

Well I was, I was in 21. Yeah what made you come back then? Well I came back on a visit. Oh I see. My aunt at that time was living there I think around Steya and Saratoga or something along there. So I came back. You stayed a good while? Yeah I stayed about a month. Oh I see. Yeah just about a month. Then I went and they kept writing to me and come on we got some jobs and things like that. That's when you were just getting into it? Yeah but I didn't, during that month I didn't play. I just sat in with the. You went around and saw the fellow. Yeah. Yeah.
